economy.summary: Her campaign site says she authored a constitutional amendment to give Pennsylvania workers the right to organize, introduced a Fair Workweek bill for predictable schedules and pay, helped expand the state Property Tax and Rent Rebate program, and voted for legislation to raise Pennsylvania's minimum wage to $15 an hour.
economy.short: Authored worker organizing amendment; voted to raise minimum wage.

taxes.summary: Her campaign site says she supports tax increases on the super rich and big corporations to fund community investment, and that her Combined Reporting legislation would close loopholes used by corporations and lower taxes for most South Philadelphians.
taxes.short: Supports taxing the wealthy and corporations; closing corporate loopholes.

abortion.summary: According to her Pennsylvania House office, she and Democratic colleagues in the House introduced a package of legislation aimed at protecting and expanding access to abortion and other healthcare services.
abortion.short: Introduced legislation to protect and expand access to abortion.

education.summary: Her campaign site says she has fought to secure more public school funding, citing $175 million she brought back for school facilities, and supports reasonable class sizes, fair teacher compensation, union representation, and timely contracts.
education.short: Fought for school funding; supports smaller classes, fair pay.

healthcare.summary: Her campaign site says healthcare is a human right and that, as a co-chair of the Medicare for All Caucus, she is working to make Pennsylvania a national model for care that prioritizes people over corporate profits.
healthcare.short: Co-chairs Medicare for All Caucus; calls healthcare a right.

energy.summary: Her campaign site says she supports a ban on fracking and major investments in renewable energy, public transit, and climate adaptation, and that her Solar for Schools legislation would reduce school energy costs and reliance on fossil fuels.
energy.short: Supports fracking ban, renewable energy investment, and Solar for Schools.

guns.summary: As a state representative she was a cosponsor of House Bill 1018 in the 2023-2024 session, which would establish extreme risk protection orders allowing courts to temporarily bar firearm possession by people deemed to present a substantial risk of harm.
guns.short: Cosponsored bill to establish extreme risk protection orders.
